cases.note: the toolbox, the dataZoom, the tooltip, the axis pointer and the graph-less adjacency actions on a bar chart
a tree: its actions, a node's click (TreeView dispatches treeExpandAndCollapse), a drag and a wheel (its RoamController dispatches treeRoam)
a graph (layout none): its roam through the action and through the RoamController's drag and wheel
a sankey with roam: the RoamController's drag and wheel dispatch sankeyRoam

splitArea.note: a value y axis, the list [vertical gradient, grey]: every other band its own vertical ramp
a category x axis, one horizontal gradient: each band its own horizontal ramp
a polar angle axis, [vertical gradient, grey]: the bands of each colour merged, one ramp over their box
a polar radius axis, [horizontal gradient, grey]: the rings of each colour merged
a radar (polygon), [vertical gradient, grey]: RadarView merges the bands of one colour
a radar (circle), one horizontal gradient for every ring

zlevel.note: a title of zlevel 2 over a series of zlevel 1: drawn and hit over it
a title of the default zlevel (0, whatever z) under a series of zlevel 1
the root's zlevel 1: the axes (no zlevel of their own) take it, the series and the title (theirs, 0) do not: the axis line over the bar, the title under the axes
an x axis of zlevel 2 over a bar of the default zlevel
the same at the default zlevel: the bar (z 2) over the axis (z 0)
a legend of zlevel 2 over a series of zlevel 1
a toolbox of zlevel 2 over a series of zlevel 1: its icon is the hover
the loading mask (zlevel 0) under a series of zlevel 1: the symbol is drawn and hit over it; off the symbol the mask
a loading mask of zlevel 2 over the series of zlevel 1
a graphic rect of zlevel 2 over a title of zlevel 1 (the title over the series of 0)
a large progressive scatter of zlevel 1 drawn chunk by chunk over a title of the default zlevel: its points over the title once drawn
a title of the default zlevel under a series of 1, with an x axis of 2: the canvases drawn level by level, the title on its own
the large progressive scatter of zlevel 1, half opaque, over the title of 0: a symbol off the title blended once over the white
a toolbox of zlevel 2 over the loading mask (0): its icon is the hover, not the mask
